Entry.English:
Interdimensional is a perturbation in space-time. Discovered between Saturn and Uranus, the portal leads to a reality which is a distorted echo of our own.

Days appear to last for 24 hours.

Interdimensional maps are a combination of Mars, Ceres, Io, and Europa. Maps feature terrain and buildings from up to all four locations.

Patent availability is randomized.

Guaranteed Patents: Energy Vault, Financial Instruments, Geothermal/Hydrothermal Borehole, Virtual Reality, and Thinking Machines.
